text_block_list.text:
At the training grounds. —She is always 
here.

On days we train, and on days we don't. 
Rain or shine, no matter what happens.

text_block_list.name: Opera O & Doto
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah! Taaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Haaan, the Overlord T.M. Opera O, as 
gallant and radiant as ever today~. And...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"And the devoted gaze with which Meisho 
Doto looks up to her and follows along. 
Aahh, what pure, sacred bliss♪"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Could both of them actually have deep 
feelings about this?! Catching up at some 
point, being welcomed in, and then, 
finally...!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Nnngh~ That's the stuff!!

—Her name is Agnes Digital. Just an 
ordinary(?) Umamusume you could find 
anywhere. And—

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer! My fellow comrade! The 
Umamusume are looking fantastic as always 
today!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Come, sit right next to me. The front row 
is open. Let us offer our prayers to our 
precious favorite today as well.

"—A pure Umamusume fanatic. She assumes 
that I, her Trainer, am just as much of an 
Umamusume nerd as she is."
choice_data_list:
By the way, I need to talk to you about 
something.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ah, yes, what's up? Did you happen to find 
some fresh recruit who's close to making 
their debut?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Ooooh, impressive! ...And what was your 
name again?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Mhfufu, that's not a bad name at all. 
Agnes Digita...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: Eeeh?! You don't mean...
choice_data_list: Your debut in the Twinkle Series is set.
Your debut in the Twinkle Series is set!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Hyowaa~! F-Finally, the heavenly paradise, 
the Twinkle Series?!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Which means I'll actually get to worship 
those heavenly Umamusume, who used to be 
totally out of reach, right before my very 
eyes!?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Muhehe, Digi-tan is in heaven~. There are 
so many precious Umamusume I stan on both 
turf and dirt paths~.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you remember, right?! The promise 
we made that day.

—A promise. There's no way I'd forget. 
That was what Agnes Digital...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Wait, what did you just say...? —You're 
not picking a course? You're running both?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
With how I am now, you think I can run any 
course?! Even if I can't stand alongside 
my fave, you think I can at least steel my 
resolve...?!
choice_data_list: Let's aim to become an all-rounder!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text: AND IIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIIII—!!!!!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Alright—my mind is made up!! Digitan is 
going to become an all-rounder!! So I can 
experience all my faves up close and 
personal!!!

"I will have you run on both turf and 
dirt." That was the promise we made when 
we signed our trainer contract.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Digitan is an all-rounder! With these legs 
forged from chasing after my faves, I can 
get right next to any Uma Musume!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
And so, in order to gaze upon that 
Archangel Umamusume-chan from the highest 
tier of heaven, I shall keep on 
accumulating good karma!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Oh my, if it isn't Digital-san. Good day 
to you~

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
"I could have sworn I just heard someone 
say 'My debut has been decided'..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Huh... Opera O-san and Doto-san... 
Th-That's...

These two are T.M. Opera O and Meisho 
Doto. They're Umamusume from the 
generation ahead of us.

T.M. Opera O is a narcissist who walks the 
walk. Having already won a graded race, 
she is a leading contender for the 
Classics.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Bwahahaha! This year's Satsuki Sho is as 
good as won by this Supreme Overlord!

Meisho Doto, on the other hand, is a bit 
of a klutz. She hasn't produced big 
results yet, but word is she possesses 
tremendous latent power.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauuu~, I'm still no match for Opera 
O-san, but I'll do my veeery beeest.

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun. If your debut is truly set, 
it is certainly something to celebrate, 
but...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
L-Like I said, my debut isn't decided yet. 
Isn't that just a baseless rumor on social 
media?
choice_data_list: I told you it was settled, didn't I?
I told you it was settled, didn't I?

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Shh, shh! Trainer, you can't say it~! 
We're clams! We don't speak!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Ahahaha! In other words, it's like this.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun fears the 'observer effect.' 
Specifically, "making them conscious of 
her own presence."

text_block_list.name: TM Opera O
text_block_list.text:
You are—Agnes Tachyon. Digital's 
roommate...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
As an Umamusume researcher, observing her 
day and night makes her true nature and 
inclinations plain as day.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Digital-kun is afraid that her very 
presence might bother the other Uma 
Musume.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
I-I wouldn't say I'm scared, exactly~ More 
like it feels presumptuous to even take up 
your time~

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
For someone like myself, quietly peeking 
from behind a private list is more than 
enough...

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
So please, go right ahead! Don't mind me 
at all, just let noble figures like 
yourselves enjoy a pleasant chat~.

Agnes Digital's creed: She believes that 
'as just a fan, she must maintain a clear 
boundary with the Umamusume she idolizes.'

"She seems a bit too timid for someone 
who's about to stand on the same field and 
compete with us, but..."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Well now, that being said, participating 
in this Series is a golden ticket! I 
intend to savor it right down to the bone!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
"I'll run alongside you so I don't get in 
the way, and quietly support you from up 
close!"

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
Now that that's settled, Trainer, let's 
get right into training!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Digital
text_block_list.text:
The track that Opera O-san and Doto-san 
just finished running on! The lingering 
scent of preciousness... Whoa, hell yeah!

Agnes Digital was overwhelmingly excited 
about her long-awaited debut. Eccentric as 
she was, there was an endearing charm to 
this Umamusume, and I resolved to watch 
over her journey.
